content.rationale: S2-own fixes that a change's files are attributed through the ownership rule — its node file plus its ref-listed paths, nothing else, never by scanning; S2-own-inline fixes the degenerate case (inline ref yields the node file alone); D2 states the rule. It derives from an already-loaded document and a parsed id, naming the node file through store_path so there is one layout. I1-serde (`orrvsxqq`) fixes the JSON layer the module is written against — serde and serde_json, the crate's own `Value` and the derive.
